problems.problem: Potential delay in responding to weekend or after-hours quote requests while the shop is closed Friday through Sunday.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The shop's stated hours are Monday through Thursday 7:00 AM to 4:30 PM and closed Friday through Sunday, and no automated instant-reply or chat system is visible on the public site.

problems.problem: Manual back-and-forth to collect drawings, measurements, and photos when prospects initially submit only a text message via the website quote form.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The website quote form includes only Name, Email, Phone, and Message fields without a file upload field, whereas the service page notes that drawings, photos, and field sizes are needed for quoting.

existingSolutions.solution: Standard web form file upload field and automated email autoresponder via existing website or email provider
existingSolutions.addresses: Collecting drawings/photos upfront and acknowledging inquiries submitted outside Monday–Thursday shop hours

existingSolutions.solution: Job-shop ERP/estimating software (such as JobBOSS, ECI M1, or QuickBooks with job costing)
existingSolutions.addresses: Quote tracking and shop scheduling for custom metal fabrication

feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is a custom metal fabrication job shop outside ForgeX's target segment of HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors.

humanReview: Custom metal fabrication quotes require human review of engineering drawings, material thicknesses, tolerances, and shop capacity.

risks.description: Custom fabrication relies on precise physical specifications, drawings, and material selection; automating quote generation or scope advice without human estimator review could result in misquoted jobs or structural safety issues.

assumptions: The website displays no prices, average project values, lead volumes, or employee headcount, so commercial value cannot be calculated.

questions: How many fabrication quote requests do you typically receive per week via phone, email, and your website form?
What software do you currently use to track incoming drawings, estimates, and shop jobs?
How many staff members work in the shop and office?

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identity, services, review count, service areas, reCAPTCHA and tag manager usage, and contact details
Company history, founding date (April 4, 1993), and business description
General metal fabrication FAQs and service scope verification
Physical address, operating hours (Mon–Thu 7:00 AM–4:30 PM), and official contact channel
Quoting workflow, drawing/measurement intake process, and shop operations

limitations: The website does not state the company's employee count or revenue.
The website does not identify any owners, executives, or managers by title (individuals are only mentioned in client review quotes).
The website does not list state contractor license numbers or internal shop/accounting software.
The website does not publish service pricing or paid lead-generation evidence.

qualification.rationale: Erwin Custom Fabrication is a custom metal fabrication and welding shop (structural steel, sheet metal, aluminum, stainless steel, laser cutting, gates, range hoods, and tanks) rather than a residential HVAC, plumbing, or electrical contractor. In addition, its employee count and paid lead-generation activity cannot be verified from the public website, placing it outside ForgeX's target segment.
